newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argosy Gaming cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argosy Gaming cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Argosy Gaming Co to underperform from hold.
-- said cut the 1997 earnings estimate to a loss of $0.35 a share from a loss of $0.05 a share.
-- Trimmed the 1998 earnings estimate to a loss $0.25 a share from a profit of $0.05 a share.
-- said the company's cash interest coverage is minimal.
-- said if the opening of Lawrenceburg facility is delayed or other properties underperform expectations, Salomon would begin "to question the company's ability to make its future interest payments."
